correctness.rationale: Finite-universe convex+union-closed families are precisely upper families below their maximal union. This form is closed under strict split by extending witness partitions. The package checker independently verifies all 1043 instances of 3-uniform hypergraph 2-colorability for 2–5 vertices, Fano failure, and three small expressivity censuses; these finite checks are supplementary.
